## v5.3.0 — one line at start says a hosted tier exists, and SLACK_MCP_NO_UPSELL=1 hides it

When a server starts it now prints one line on stderr:

```
Hosted tier: Runs your saved catch-up on a schedule while your laptop is closed. There is a free tier; scheduled delivery is on the paid plans. https://mcp.revasserlabs.com (hide this line with SLACK_MCP_NO_UPSELL=1)
```

The stdio server and the HTTP server print it once per process. `slack_health_check` returns the same sentence in a new `hosted_tier` field.

Neither makes a network call or sends anything. Nothing is written to stdout, which stays the MCP channel. `SLACK_MCP_NO_UPSELL=1` hides both. It is the setting that already drops the hosted option from the expired-session message, so one setting covers every mention.

### Added

- One line on stderr at start, from the stdio and HTTP servers.
- A `hosted_tier` field in the `slack_health_check` result.

### Compatibility

The 20 tools and their schemas are unchanged. The only change to a tool result is the added `hosted_tier` field, which is absent when `SLACK_MCP_NO_UPSELL=1`. The package still talks only to Slack. Requires Node 20 or later.

### Install

```sh
npx -y @jtalk22/slack-mcp@latest --setup
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jtalk22/slack-mcp-server/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#530---2026-11-17)
